slides.headline: Microsoft just quit the AI assistant war
Copilot rebooted for work, not you
slides.body: New Copilot focuses on Office apps and business data, drops the friendly chatbot personality.

slides.headline: No more race to be your daily AI
slides.body: Microsoft admits it can't beat ChatGPT or Gemini for personal use, so it stopped trying.

slides.headline: Your Windows AI gets quieter
slides.body: The Copilot button on your PC will push work summaries, not conversation or creative help.

slides.headline: You still pay for the features you lose
slides.body: Copilot Pro stays $20/month but drops the chat experience that made it feel useful at home.

slides.headline: Who actually wins now?
slides.body: Follow for the AI shifts that change what's on your phone and laptop.
